typesense:popular.greeting:
You live in a terrible and difficult time, in the Middle Ages, in this world you will meet cruel goblins, huge dragons and other dangerous creatures, each of which will want to kill, eat.
In this world there are skilled gnomes, beautiful and smart elves, cunning lizardmen, dangerous beastmen and many ordinary people.

Describe your character, his name, race, gender, appearance and abilities.
typesense:popular.name: Dark fantasy RPG
typesense:popular.title: You live in a terrible and difficult time, in the fantasy world

title_i18n.ar: أنت تعيش في زمن رهيب وصعب، في عالم الخيال
title_i18n.de: Du lebst in einer schrecklichen und schwierigen Zeit, in der Fantasy-Welt
title_i18n.es: Vives en una época terrible y difícil, en el mundo de la fantasía
title_i18n.fr: Vous vivez dans une époque terrible et difficile, dans le monde fantastique
title_i18n.hi: आप एक भयानक और कठिन समय में रहते हैं, कल्पनिक दुनिया में
title_i18n.it: Vivi in un'epoca terribile e difficile, nel mondo fantasy
title_i18n.ja: あなたは恐ろしく困難な時代に、ファンタジーの世界に生きている
title_i18n.ko: 당신은 끔찍하고 어려운 시기에, 판타지 세계에 살고 있습니다
title_i18n.pl: Żyjesz w strasznym i trudnym czasie, w świecie fantasy
title_i18n.pt: Você vive em uma época terrível e difícil, no mundo da fantasia
title_i18n.ru: Вы живёте в ужасное и трудное время, в мире фэнтези
title_i18n.tr: Korkunç ve zor bir dönemde, fantezi dünyasında yaşıyorsun
title_i18n.zh: 你生活在一个可怕而艰难的时代，在幻想世界中
